ceterms:description.en-US: Students complete a comprehensive software capstone project during their final year of undergraduate studies. The project is done over 2 semesters in phases: concept, formal proposal, implementation, and presentation. The projects include and may require the integration of software and human factors and hardware elements and are developed to software engineering methodologies. Pre- or Corequisite: CSCE 35103. Prerequisite: (CSCE 36103 or CSCE 361H3) and completion of 72 credit hours. (Typically offered: Fall)

languageModel.name: qwen3.5:9b
languageModel.argument: The sentence contains an 'and' connecting two main components: the parenthetical group '(CSCE 36103 or CSCE 361H3)' and the phrase 'completion of 72 credit hours'. According to the CTDL definition of ceterms:alternativeCondition, which applies to the parenthetical group containing 'or', this represents a set where 'any one path fulfills the parent condition', thus forming an 'any_of' node. The outer 'and' connects these two distinct requirements, meaning every item under it is required, forming an 'all_of' node per the CTDL definition of ceterms:requires.

confidence.why: A language model proposed it, and no person has confirmed it.
